name: coupling economies-of-scale (financial channel)
incentive: two live on ~1.5x one income -> a marginal child becomes affordable
evidence: OECD eq.1.5 -> 25% cheaper/person; Taiwan lottery ~25% via marriage; Korea +1.0pp

name: single-parent precarity
evidence: US single-mother poverty 31.3% vs 5.4% (~5.8x); bites higher parities (P-bar penalty)

name: solo-parent support (benefit-cliff)
incentive: de-risking solo parenthood raises fertility but a cliff perversely delays cohabitation
evidence: support COMPLEMENTS coupling (premium persists Nordic/France); past s~0.5 a cliff delays cohabitation

name: reward union duration (de-risk vs lock-in)
incentive: de-risk dissolution via economic security/childcare, NOT bonuses/status/lock-in
evidence: stability saturates, trap explodes -> interior-low rw*=0.28; de-risk durable P-bar ~0.08 -> Korea +2.2pp

name: duration bonuses / anniversary holiday / longevity medals
evidence: Soviet medals / anniversary holidays symbolic-null; no causal behavioural evidence; stability factors are internal

name: lock-in / covenant marriage / adultery penalty
incentive: raising exit cost removes the outside-option bargaining that de-escalates coercion
evidence: S-W: no-fault divorce cut female suicide ~20%, DV ~30%; net-of-harm negative; the exit IS the valve

name: school finance + communication education
incentive: reduce the stressors that dissolve unions (money arguments, communication)
evidence: PREP RCT divorce 2.03% vs 6.20% (~67% risk cut); Dew: finance arguments top divorce predictor; general-pop replication weaker

name: infidelity norm / stigma (soft, non-legal)
incentive: raise the social cost of infidelity without a legal penalty
evidence: softer than legal penalty; modest fidelity lift dominated by a shaming side-cost; no fertility evidence

name: pornography ban as a fertility lever
evidence: Twenge 2017: sex-recession is partnership decline NOT porn; Perry 2018 porn->divorce OR~2.19 observational; ban high-delta (VPN), symbolic

name: Amish / enclosed-community fertility
incentive: media-abstention high-fidelity community as a template
evidence: Amish TFR~6.9, doubles ~20y, retention ~85% - but retention/endogamy not porn-abstention drives it; confounded, non-portable

name: universal vs means-tested
incentive: a means-test cliff is a perverse 'stay-below-threshold' incentive
evidence: universal net 0.150 > hard-means-test 0.006; the cliff + non-take-up dominate targeting savings

name: benefit form (cash/in-kind/time)
incentive: form matters more than size: in-kind persists, cash erodes
evidence: in-kind net 0.250 > cash 0.060 (eroding) and time 0.109; Korea in-kind +7.4pp vs cash +1.8pp

name: credible permanence
incentive: fertility is a 25-yr bet; a temporary policy is discounted to tempo
evidence: temporary 0.080 vs credible-lock 0.196; reframes 'durability' as credibility (Hungary reversible = tempo)

name: geographic scale
incentive: local baby-bonuses relocate births (beggar-thy-neighbor), not raise the level
evidence: national 0.120 vs hyper-local 0.036; Korea municipal bonuses partly relocation (Kim 2023)

name: who pays (state vs employer mandate)
incentive: an employer maternity mandate triggers statistical hiring discrimination
evidence: state-funded 0.150 vs employer-mandate -0.102 (net NEGATIVE); widens the Kleven -31% penalty; flips ~0.60

name: surrogate-carrier market (conditioned class)
incentive: pay a class of women to gestate others' children - decouples childbearing from the career clock
evidence: demand lift tiny (Korea +0.33pp, rounding error); class DOMINATED (score -0.57); India banned the hub for exploitation; Israel above-replacement = subsidised IVF not a carrier class

name: optimum-type taxonomy
incentive: different levers have different optimum geometries
evidence: 5 distinct optimum types coexist: interior=6; corner=3; sign-flip=2; descriptive=2; null=2

name: robust vs fragile bundle (Seldon manifold)
incentive: a valve-paired defection-robust bundle crosses where the coercive bundle stalls
evidence: robust push +0.471 -> n->1.49 (recovery); fragile push -0.186 -> n->-0.32 (stall)
